title: The Prayer Ribbons
text: A tree hung with thousands of prayer ribbons, one tied by every pilgrim who passed, faded to grey by sun and rain. They rustle like whispers in the wind. Some are your House's colors, tied by Scions long dead.

options.label: Tie a ribbon for the House.

outcomes.text: A prayer for the House, among a thousand others, whispering with them.

options.label: The wisest reads your House's old ribbons.

outcomes.text: Prayers of your ancestors, and one secret they should not have tied to a tree.
Petty, and satisfying, and the whispering stops for a moment.
